svg.text: STAGE 432 · TOPIC 72 · P857 / P858 · SVG 76 · 435 DIMS 🎉
WebRTC RFC 8656 (TURN) Peer-SSRF Relay Bounce, ChannelData Framing & Lifetime Quota Guard
WebRTC RFC 8656 TURN 内网/IMDS 防 SSRF 中继反射（[1,8] 权限）、0x4000-0x7FFF ChannelData 分帧对齐与 [60,600]s 租期配额门禁（🎉 435 大评测维度里程碑）
1. TURN XOR-PEER-ADDRESS Anti-SSRF & Permission Gate (P857)
• 痛点：客户端利用合法 TURN 凭证将 XOR-PEER-ADDRESS 指向 169.254.169.254 或 10/8 内网
• 放大风险：单个 Allocation 绑定数十个对端 IP 实施内网扫描与 UDP 流量反射放大
❌ SSRF Bounce: ChannelBind XOR-PEER=169.254.169.254:80 | 32 permissions
✅ P857 Gate: SFU VIP Allowlist Only (STUN 403) + Permissions in [1, 8]
Action: reject_turn_peer_ssrf_with_403_and_clamp_permissions
确定性收敛指标（P857）：
✔ clampedInternalSsrfOrLoopbackRelayAttempts = 0（100% 阻断环回/IMDS/私网中继反射）
✔ clampedActivePeerPermissionsPerAllocation ∈ [1, 8]（杜绝权限表爆炸与扫描扇出）
2. ChannelData 4B Framing & [60, 600]s Lifetime Gate (P858)
• 痛点：TURN-TCP 下 ChannelData 越出 0x4000-0x7FFF 或缺 4B 对齐 Padding 引发流失步越界读
• 枯竭风险：客户端申请 LIFETIME=7200s 长期霸占公网中继 UDP 端口池导致新呼叫失败
❌ Desync & Exhaust: ch=0x0100, len=65535 (pkt=60B) | LIFETIME=7200s
✅ P858 Gate: ch in [0x4000,0x7FFF] + 4B Padded Closure + LIFETIME in [60,600]s
Action: drop_malformed_channeldata_and_clamp_allocation_lifetime
确定性收敛指标（P858）：
✔ clampedMalformedChannelDataOrQuotaViolations = 0（0 越界/失步 ChannelData 帧）
✔ clampedTurnAllocationLifetimeSeconds ∈ [60, 600] s（中继端口周转率提升 12 倍）
3. Quantitative Evaluation Matrix & Production Verification Checklist (Stage 432 · 435 Dims 🎉 · 867 Guardrails · 876 Probes)
• Guardrail P857: evaluateWebrtcTurnRfc8656CreatePermissionChannelBindPrivateSubnetImdsSsrfRelayBounceGate => 0 SSRF | [1, 8] perms
• Guardrail P858: evaluateWebrtcTurnRfc8656ChannelDataFramingDesyncAndAllocationLifetimeQuotaGate => 0 desync | [60, 600]s
• Checklist: [x] Block 127/8, 169.254/16, RFC1918 [x] SFU VIP Allowlist [x] 0x4000-0x7FFF 4B Padding [x] [60, 600]s Lifetime
